description: Use this when someone asks for the square footage, square meters or floor area of a room, a house or an apartment, including Wohnfläche and loi Carrez. Adds up the floor area of rooms or parts of a floor, each a rectangle (length × width), a triangle (base × height ÷ 2) or a circle (by its diameter), and takes away parts marked to subtract, such as a closet or an opening to the floor below. Returns, in square meters, each part's own area and the area it adds, the floor area of all parts, and the total as the method counts it (1 m² = 10.7639 sq ft; 1 sq yd = 0.83613 m²). Methods: plain (the default; every part at its full area), woflv (Germany, Wohnflächenverordnung: clear height of 2 m or more in full, 1 m to under 2 m half, under 1 m not at all; unheated winter gardens half; balconies, loggias, roof gardens and terraces a quarter, the usual share; cellars, attics and garages not at all), carrez (France, loi Carrez: closed and covered space with a clear height of 1.80 m or more; balconies, terraces, cellars and garages not at all).

method.description: How the area is counted; plain when left out.

parts.description: The rooms or parts of the floor, at least one.

height.description: Clear height above the part, in millimeters; for a rectangle under a ceiling that slopes across its width, the heights along its two sides of the given length. Full height unless set. Only woflv and carrez use it.

kind.description: What the part is, for woflv and carrez: room (the default), balcony (also a loggia, roof garden or terrace), winterGarden (unheated and closed on all sides, such as a veranda), attic (not finished as a room), cellar (also a storage, boiler or laundry room outside the home), garage (also a parking space).

length.description: The rectangle's length, the triangle's base or the circle's diameter, in millimeters.

subtract.description: True to take the part away, such as a closet, a kitchen island or an opening to the floor below.

width.description: The rectangle's width, or the triangle's height at a right angle to its base (none for a circle), in millimeters.

name: calculate_floor_area
title: Square footage calculator
